intro.title: Let's build your system.
intro.body: COSMO brings your tasks, calendar, habits and goals together. In four steps you write down what is on your mind, fit it into your week, and pick a habit and a goal. Everything you write is saved.
intro.legendHabits: what you keep up every day
intro.businessBody: You started setting up a company space. You can pick it up now, or later from the Company entry in the menu.

tasks.title: What do you need to do this week?
tasks.body: Everything starts with a task: one specific thing you check off once it's done. Write down what's on your mind. Priority, category and due date can come later.
tasks.limit: Five to start with is plenty.
tasks.tip: In COSMO, the N key adds a task from any page.
tasks.previewEmpty: Your tasks will show up here as you type.
tasks.alreadyHint: You can edit them in Tasks. Add more if you like.

agenda.title: Give your tasks a place.
agenda.body: The calendar shows your week hour by hour. Put a task on it and it becomes a time slot, so you know exactly when you'll do it.
agenda.point1: Drag a task from the calendar's side panel.
agenda.point2: Stretch the slot to give it its real duration.
agenda.point3: A task without a slot stays in your list: nothing gets lost.
agenda.slotHint: Optional. The slot will show up in your calendar, linked to the task.
agenda.noTask: Add a task in the previous step to try it with your own.

habits.title: A habit you want to keep up?
habits.body: Tick a habit off every day you keep it. COSMO tracks your streak and shows you, week after week, what you really stick to.
habits.previewCaption: Every checked box makes the streak longer.
habits.alreadyCreated: Habit added: {{name}}. You can edit it in Habits.

okr.title: A goal for the next three months?
okr.body: A goal sets the direction. The key result, optional, tells you how you'll know you got there. Link your tasks to it: each one you finish moves the gauge.
okr.placeholder: e.g. Launch v2 of the product
okr.previewCaption: A linked task gets done, and the gauge moves.
okr.targetHint: Without a number, the key result is simply ticked off once reached.
okr.alreadyCreated: Goal added: {{name}}. You can flesh it out in Goals.

done.title: Your system is up and running.
done.body: Everything you created is already in COSMO. Every task you tick off and every habit you keep feeds your statistics.
done.recapNothing: Nothing yet, and that is fine: you can add anything in a few taps from the app.
done.next: Each page will walk you through its main features the first time you open it.
done.statsToday_one: {{count}} item added today: your week is underway.
done.statsToday_other: {{count}} items added today: your week is underway.
done.statsEmpty: They will fill up as soon as you tick off your first task.

video.title: Welcome to {{org}}.
video.subtitle: A two-and-a-half-minute tour of your company space (in French, with subtitles).
